Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the heads-up. Short answer: Coupa-style invites need to land on a specific mailbox (an individual or an address that can receive interactive emails). If an invite was forwarded to a Google Group, the portal sometimes creates a vendor contact record tied to the group address rather than an individual user — that explains the 'account not found' when Ravi clicks the activation link.

Two paths:
- Quick fix (recommended): Ask IT to resend the invite directly to ravi.kumar@greenhavenco.com. I'll stand by to manually map the incoming vendor contact to Ravi so POs stay attached.
- Recovery option: If you prefer we preserve the current submission, we can convert the group-based contact into an individual contact on our side, but that requires a short admin action and a CSV export to avoid losing PO associations.

Can you confirm which you prefer? If you go with the quick fix, please resend and reply-all; Ben and Monica will watch the admin console and perform the manual mapping. If you'd like us to do the conversion, I'll ask for a screenshot of the vendor profile page and we'll export the vendor data.

Aisha
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
